Oneliner

IoT constellation demonstration.
Description

Demonstrate autonomous orbit control maneuvers with Aliena’s miniature Hall-thruster and NuSpace’s attitude determination and control system. Will also house an an Internet-of-Things (IoT) payload for NuSpace, which plans to establish an IoT constellation.
